RESOLUTION.DESC:
The Security Council,
Recognizing SC#11 “Liberate Democratia” as this body’s fourth ever liberation of a region, with the stated intent of rescuing it from invasion,
Finding that the region has long been rendered entirely inactive, without much hope for a revival of its old community,
Concluding that without a native community to protect, the liberation’s original purpose of protecting those natives has been rendered obsolete,
Noting that regional governor [nation]Fire Eaters[/nation] has frequently ceased to exist in the past, thereby leaving the region defenceless against invasion,
Asserting that despite this potential vulnerability, thousands of other regions consistently lack an executive governor to ensure regional security without being at any noteworthy risk of occupation,
Understanding that Democratia itself has not seen even trivial forms of raiding in years, and lacks any outstanding characteristics that may lead to it becoming a particularly enticing target in the future,
Affirming that liberations exist to meet exigent or continuing circumstances that warrant them, and
Disappointed that this resolution fails to differentiate itself whatsoever from the nearly identical [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=WA_past_resolution/id=11/council=2]SC#4 “Liberate Belgium,”[/url]
Hereby repeals Security Council Resolution 11 “Liberate Democratia.”
RESOLUTION.NAME: Repeal "Liberate Democratia"
